title: Financial Analyst
description: Analyze financial data, build 3-statement financial models in Excel, evaluate corporate valuations, and prepare financial reports.

nodes.title: Financial Accounting Fundamentals
nodes.description: Understand double-entry bookkeeping, GAAP & IFRS accounting standards, debit/credit rules, and ledger accounts.

nodes.title: Three-Statement Analysis
nodes.description: Analyze Income Statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow Statements and understand inter-statement linkages.

nodes.title: Financial Modeling in Excel
nodes.description: Master Excel financial formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP), scenario analysis, dynamic formatting, and DCF modeling.

nodes.title: Corporate Valuation & Multiples
nodes.description: Evaluate companies using Comparable Company Analysis (Comps), Precedent Transactions, and LBO models.

nodes.title: Financial Reporting & Capstone Case Studies
nodes.description: Prepare executive financial slide decks, variance analysis, investment committee memos, and equity research reports.
